label: rx_7900_xtx_patches
note: online_f32 only (offline is unaffected by patches): the emulator is trained on patches of at most 512 cells, Adam sweeping them in mini-batches of 3 patches (400 m: 15 patches of 501 x 451, 300 m: 24 of 501 x 501, 200 m: 54 of 501 x 501). On this GPU the mini-batches keep MIOpen on a Winograd weight-gradient kernel instead of GemmWrwUniversal (results/rx_7900_xtx/miopen_wrw.md). 1600 m and 800 m rows come from the one-batch run (patches_per_batch=99): 2 patches at 1600 m, which is the same configuration, and all 6 patches in one batch at 800 m. 200 m run with TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=16384 because TensorFlow allocates the work buffer of the largest applicable MIOpen algorithm (GEMM, 11.7 GB) for the whole-grid forward convolution before find; MIOpen then chooses Winograd (no work buffer).
